verdict.rationale: Openness of source code is a fair question for any software product, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows public GitHub repos for client SDKs and the API specification, with no license stated. Nothing shows that Square's own product source is readable under an open license; SDK repos are adjacent developer building blocks, not the product itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
